thought.text: Image pulled. Now let me generate a secret key and start the all-in-one container with persistent storage.

reasoning_content: Image pulled. Now generate secret key and run the container. Let me set up data dirs and run it.

action.command:
mkdir -p /var/lib/openproject/{pgdata,assets}
SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 64)
echo "$SECRET" > /tmp/op_secret
echo "secret length: ${#SECRET}"
docker rm -f openproject 2>/dev/null
docker run -d -p 8080:80 --name openproject \
  -e OPENPROJECT_HOST__NAME=localhost:8080 \
  -e OPENPROJECT_HTTPS=false \
  -e OPENPROJECT_DEFAULT__LANGUAGE=en \
  -e SECRET_KEY_BASE="$SECRET" \
  -v /var/lib/openproject/pgdata:/var/openproject/pgdata \
  -v /var/lib/openproject/assets:/var/openproject/assets \
  openproject/openproject:17
echo "run exit: $?"
sleep 5
docker ps --filter name=openproject
